personNameVariants.publicNote: BnF identifies Didier Mauprey as a pseudonym of Didier Bloch. “Sous le ciel de Venice” carries Didier Bloch as the printed lyricist credit.
Catalogue form used by Buxbaum/Sieghardt for the lyricist of the French version. The 1936 sheet-music cover itself credits Didier Mauprey.
